children: MJ Gleeson's update confirms views that demand remains subdued, RBC Capital Markets analysts say. The homebuilder said delivery of market consensus for pretax profit of 17 million pounds would be reliant on further improvement in buyer confidence, with profits likely to be significantly weighted toward the second half, RBC notes. This represents a change from September's view that it would be in line with consensus expectations. RBC says this language shift supports the view that consensus is materially too high. "The market must now decide whether 'reliant on' is a polite warning or simply a statement of the obvious," RBC says. Shares are down 2.5% at 269.50 pence. (anthony.orunagoriainoff@dowjones.com)
